description: Create a human drop page so ChatGPT or Claude users can upload laptop files (up to 20 per link) without dashboard login. Returns drop_url (https://www.poster.ly/drop/<token>). Send that URL to the user, wait, then call list_media. Accepts JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, MP4, MOV, WebM, and PDF up to 50MB (a PDF is for LinkedIn document posts); HEIC is not accepted. This is not the chat paperclip and not create_signed_upload.

filename.description: Optional filename hint for the user, e.g. launch-video.mp4

max_files.description: How many files the drop can accept. Default 10, max 20.

workspace_id.description: Optional. The workspace this acts in and whose plan pays (from whoami). Needed only when your connection can act in several workspaces.

name: create_media_drop
